title: A Computer Vision Approach to Visual Fraud Detection in Phishing Websites Using YOLOv8
abstract: arXiv:2609.34015v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Phishing remains one of the most common vectors for financial and identity fraud, and most detection systems still rely on inspecting a page's URL, HTML markup, or domain registration history. These signals are easy for an attacker to rotate or obfuscate, and they say very little about what actually convinces a victim to hand over a password or a card number: the way the page looks. This paper describes a visual, image-based approach to phishing detection that treats a rendered webpage the same way a human eye would, as a picture that either matches a trusted brand or doesn't. A YOLOv8 convolutional neural network was trained to classify full-page website screenshots as phishing or legitimate based on layout, logo placement, color scheme, and login-form structure, rather than on text extracted from the page. The system reached 92% classification accuracy on a held-out test set, processed a single screenshot in roughly 100 millisecond

translated_title: 使用YOLOv8的计算机视觉方法对钓鱼网站进行视觉欺诈检测
translated_abstract: 钓鱼攻击仍然是金融和身份欺诈最常见的手段之一，而大多数检测系统仍然依赖于检查页面的URL、HTML标记或域名注册历史。这些信号很容易被攻击者轮换或混淆，而且它们对于真正说服受害者交出密码或银行卡号的关键因素——页面的外观——几乎没有任何说明。本文描述了一种基于视觉、图像的钓鱼检测方法，该方法像人眼一样看待渲染后的网页，将其视为一张要么与可信品牌相符、要么不相符的图片。研究训练了一个YOLOv8卷积神经网络，基于页面布局、徽标位置、配色方案和登录表单结构，而非从页面中提取的文本，将整页网站截图分类为钓鱼或合法。该系统在保留测试集上达到了92%的分类准确率，处理单张截图大约需要100毫秒。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于YOLOv8的图像化钓鱼网站检测方法，通过分析网页截图的布局、徽标位置、配色方案和登录表单结构等视觉特征来识别钓鱼页面，达到92%的分类准确率，且单张截图处理时间约为100毫秒。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a visual phishing detection approach using YOLOv8 to classify full-page website screenshots as phishing or legitimate based on layout, logo placement, color scheme, and login-form structure, achieving 92% accuracy with roughly 100ms processing time per screenshot.
